items.title: FDA approves Teva’s monthly injection of olanzapine for schizophrenia
items.summary: Teva said it is debuting the drug to overcome adherence issues with an oral counterpart and improve symptom outcomes.

items.title: FDA approves Asahi Kasei’s Hovilpri for refractory HSV
items.summary: The US FDA has approved Asahi Kasei Therapeutics’ Hovilpri 100mg tablets to treat refractory mucocutaneous HSV lesions in immunocompromised adults.

items.title: Perceptive, Nucleus partner to support radiopharmaceutical development
items.summary: Perceptive Discovery and Nucleus RadioPharma have announced a non-exclusive strategic partnership to assist radiopharmaceutical developers shift from initial target validation through to clinical manufacturing.

items.title: Big tech- and pharma-backed Iambic Therapeutics aims for $135m IPO
items.summary: A US listing for the oncology specialist continues a bumper year for biotech IPOs.

items.title: Roche’s Tecentriq snags FDA label expansion in type of colon cancer
items.summary: Tecentriq is now the first immunotherapy indicated for dMMR colon cancer specifically, which is often linked to a higher risk of progression after surgery.
